node.title: Budget-three multideletion equal-multifiber constructions are excluded
node.statement: Let equal-size completed blocks be unions of fibers of one X^m map, and delete pairwise-disjoint nonzero root sets R_i of sizes ell_i. The reversed top coefficients of the resulting locators are z^(ell_i-ell_0)/product_(r in R_i)(1-rz). These rational functions are independent when m>sum ell_i-ell_0. The five linear chamber profiles give thresholds 4,3,6,7,5; hence power-of-two fiber size m>=8 is excluded across all nine linear B*=3 chambers. Cycle/path already exclude m>=4. Small-fiber, mixed-map, partial-fiber, primitive, and quadratic-scroll residuals remain open.
